title: Enhancing electron transfer by ferroferric oxide during anaerobic treatment of synthetic wastewater with mixed organic carbon
description: The effect of ferroferric oxide (Fe3O4) on system performance and microbial communities was examined during anaerobic treatment of synthetic wastewater with mixed organic carbon.
center: Graduate school at Shenzhen, Tsinghua University
samples: MIMARKS Survey related sample from activated sludge metagenome
